content.title: So, Who Is Hudson Williams Girlfriend?
content.text: They just made their red carpet debut Jacob Elordi's Best Red Carpet Looks0 seconds of 0 secondsVolume 0%Loading ad00:2500:0000:59 Hudson Williams and his girlfriend Katelyn Rose Larson have made their red carpet debut — and they did it in matching black looks at the Oscars Vanity Fair afterparty. Williams wore a nipple-baring high-neck blouse from Balenciaga; Larson wore a black lace cutout gown from Bronx and Banco, with emerald-green statement earrings. The couple posed side by side on the carpet, and the internet responded accordingly. It’s been a big few months in romance for the Heated Rivalry star. In December 2025, Williams called out celebrity gossip platform Deux Moix. The Deux U podcast revealed Larson’s name and occupation on air, noting that she was a tattoo artist who had given both Williams and his Heated Rivalry co-star, Connor Storrie, matching “Sex Sells” tattoos. Williams responded to a clip of the segment on Instagram: “You know what, I’ve grown quite unfond of you, Deuxmoi.” The clip was eventually removed following backlash. Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie shot to fame from relative obscurity after starring in Heated Rivalry, a Canadian drama based on a romance series of the same name. The series kicked off a discourse about straight women’s love of the gay romance genre and caused a lot of discussion about the stars’ personal lives and sexuality. Williams has said that while he understands the interest in his relationship and sex life, it’s something he wants to keep out of the public eye. In a December 2025 interview with Deadline, he explained, “I think there’s never a question for me, when I would dream of becoming in the public eye, that I would want just a level of privacy.” Image: Instagram @hudsonwilliamsofficial On Valentine’s Day, Williams treated loyal fans to an insight into his relationship, going Instagram official with Katelyn Larson. Williams shared a camera roll collage of the pair cuddling, holidaying, and FaceTiming, with a caption that read: “with me since my 2000 gold Mazda Protege smoked and squealed and I had no job.” It seems the pair have been dating since 2020; here’s everything you need to know. Who Is Hudson Williams’ Girlfriend? Katelyn Rose Larsson has worked as a tattoo artist in British Columbia since 2023 according to her professional bio. She specialises in dainty black-and-white, and occasionally red, fine-line tattoos. In July 2025, she posted to Instagram, introducing herself to followers and sharing more about her work and background. “My name is Katelyn, I’m 24 years old and I’ve been working at Pulse Vancity for over 2 years now 🙂 I specialize in fineline tattoos,” she wrote. Williams posted supportively on the post: “SHE’S A KILLER 🔥.” She said her favourite tattoos to do were back pieces ‘but I love every single tattoo that I get to do.” Despite being the internet’s boyfriend, Hudson Williams has said fans have responded well to the news he is off the market. Asked about how they reacted to his Valentine’s Day post by ETalk Canada, he said that while he “didn’t even check his DMs” after sharing the photos, fans are being “really warm” to Larson. While he’s arguably the more extroverted member of the Heated Rivalry duo, Williams’ girlfriend doesn’t share the same quality. “Even though she’s not trying to be out there or be perceived,” he told the publication. “I’m sure they’re probably the exact same, but I think everyone just sees her, takes her in stride, and all the lovely fans supporting her even though she’s not even trying to be out there or be really perceived. She’s like, ‘I don’t want to be perceived.’ But they’re still just being really warm, from what I’ve been told, and that’s really nice.” Ruby Feneley Senior Writer, Fashion + Beauty Ruby is a journalist and editor with a career spanning beauty, fashion, culture and lifestyle. After completing a Bachelor of Arts (English Literature/Gender and Culture Studies) at the University of Sydney, she started her Australian media career as a media and marketing reporter for Mumbrella. An ex-makeup artist, she quickly transitioned to beauty journalism and has held multiple in-house positions as a Beauty Editor. Ruby’s writing can be found across print and digital titles, including Dazed, GRAZIA, The Sydney Morning Herald, The Age, The Australian Financial Review, Refinery29 and marie claire. Now, she loves covering internet subcultures, TikTok trends and astrology (she is a Leo) as much as she loves scouring shopping aisles for the best non-sticky lip gloss and tracking down the perfect pencil for a faux freckle.
